power_patterns.power_structure: one holds formal approval while the other controls field evidence
one can protect the relationship while the other can trigger formal review
each controls a different indispensable resource and can veto the plan
one has procedural authority while the other has relational legitimacy
one controls public attribution while the other holds implementation knowledge
one owns the deadline while the other owns the safety or quality check
one controls external messaging while the other bears disproportionate exposure

power_patterns.mechanism: competing duties to individuals and institutions
power_patterns.power_structure: formal rank and moral responsibility point in opposite directions

power_patterns.mechanism: trust repair after an ambiguous breach
power_patterns.power_structure: both can withdraw cooperation, but only one controls the disputed record

power_patterns.mechanism: collective benefit versus uneven personal cost
power_patterns.power_structure: one aggregates outcomes while the other represents those carrying the cost

contexts.relationship_structure: a charge nurse and a regional ambulance dispatcher
contexts.goal_conflict: whether to spend the final transfer slot on a deteriorating patient or preserve it for an incoming mass-casualty alert
contexts.information_asymmetry: the nurse knows a bedside change not yet charted; the dispatcher knows the alert is less certain than the official wording suggests
contexts.history_anchor: a prior transfer request was delayed after each blamed the other's incomplete documentation
contexts.verification_node: the receiving hospital later releases its actual bed and triage log

contexts.relationship_structure: a school counselor and a parent advocate who have negotiated before
contexts.goal_conflict: whether to implement an immediate informal accommodation or wait for the committee process before examinations
contexts.information_asymmetry: the counselor knows staffing is temporarily available; the advocate knows the student has begun hiding a new symptom
contexts.history_anchor: an earlier verbal accommodation disappeared after a timetable change
contexts.verification_node: attendance and assessment records reveal whether the interim plan helped or stigmatized the student

contexts.relationship_structure: a section editor and a reporter protecting a fragile source
contexts.goal_conflict: whether to publish a time-sensitive corruption allegation with one disputed detail or hold the story and risk suppression
contexts.information_asymmetry: the reporter knows why the source cannot provide one document; the editor knows legal counsel found an undisclosed conflict
contexts.history_anchor: the editor previously defended the reporter after a correction damaged trust
contexts.verification_node: a scheduled records release later confirms some claims while complicating another

contexts.relationship_structure: a chief technology officer and the security engineer who found a flaw
contexts.goal_conflict: whether to notify customers before a funding demonstration or quietly patch first
contexts.information_asymmetry: the engineer has evidence of limited exploitation; the CTO knows disclosure could end payroll financing
contexts.history_anchor: a previous severity downgrade was never revisited after the deadline passed
contexts.verification_node: independent access logs later establish the true scope and timing

contexts.relationship_structure: siblings who jointly inherited a neighborhood bakery
contexts.goal_conflict: whether to accept a supermarket contract that prevents closure but changes recipes and staffing
contexts.information_asymmetry: one sibling knows the lender's final covenant; the other knows the oldest employees are planning a cooperative bid
contexts.history_anchor: each believes they carried the business during the other's absence
contexts.verification_node: the first contract month later reveals returns, overtime, and employee retention

contexts.relationship_structure: a national fundraising director and a flood-prone neighborhood organizer
contexts.goal_conflict: whether to launch a dramatic donor campaign using residents' stories before local consent is complete
contexts.information_asymmetry: the director knows a matching grant expires tonight; the organizer knows two featured families have privately withdrawn
contexts.history_anchor: a prior campaign raised money but left promised local control unresolved
contexts.verification_node: the funder's audit later compares consent records, funds raised, and neighborhood allocation

contexts.relationship_structure: a principal investigator and a postdoctoral researcher nearing contract renewal
contexts.goal_conflict: whether to submit a high-impact paper while an instrument anomaly remains unexplained
contexts.information_asymmetry: the postdoc knows the anomaly clusters in the strongest result; the investigator knows the lab may close without the submission
contexts.history_anchor: the investigator once credited the postdoc publicly but excluded them from a methods decision
contexts.verification_node: a blinded rerun later separates instrument drift from the biological effect

contexts.relationship_structure: a cooperative chair and the tenant treasurer
contexts.goal_conflict: whether to impose an emergency repair assessment or postpone work through another winter
contexts.information_asymmetry: the chair has an engineer's private warning; the treasurer knows several residents are one payment from eviction
contexts.history_anchor: a cheaper repair approved last year failed earlier than promised
contexts.verification_node: a follow-up inspection and hardship uptake later reveal both safety and displacement effects

contexts.relationship_structure: a warehouse lead and a volunteer captain embedded in an isolated town
contexts.goal_conflict: whether to reroute promised supplies toward a larger shelter after roads reopen
contexts.information_asymmetry: the lead knows the larger shelter's inventory report is inflated; the captain knows the isolated town has an unreported medical shortage
contexts.history_anchor: a prior reroute was interpreted locally as abandonment
contexts.verification_node: delivery scans and clinic intake later show who actually received critical supplies

contexts.relationship_structure: a conductor and a principal musician who mentors the ensemble
contexts.goal_conflict: whether to replace an ill soloist immediately or redesign the program around uncertain recovery
contexts.information_asymmetry: the conductor knows the sponsor tied funding to the advertised work; the musician knows the understudy is considering leaving after repeated exclusion
contexts.history_anchor: the ensemble previously accepted a last-minute substitution that caused resentment over credit
contexts.verification_node: rehearsal recordings and audience commitments later reveal artistic and retention costs

contexts.relationship_structure: a tribal archive curator and an external researcher with a long-standing partnership
contexts.goal_conflict: whether to digitize restricted oral histories for a grant deadline or pause for renewed community authorization
contexts.information_asymmetry: the curator knows one elder has reversed consent; the researcher knows the grant can be narrowed without total cancellation
contexts.history_anchor: an earlier project returned copies but not control over metadata
contexts.verification_node: the community council's recorded decision later defines access tiers and attribution

contexts.relationship_structure: a conservation biologist and a rancher liaison
contexts.goal_conflict: whether to begin an urgent predator relocation before compensation rules are finalized
contexts.information_asymmetry: the biologist knows delay raises animal mortality; the liaison knows one reported loss was misclassified but community anger is real
contexts.history_anchor: a previous pilot shared risks unevenly across ranches
contexts.verification_node: tag data and verified loss claims later show ecological and livelihood effects

contexts.relationship_structure: a supervising attorney and a family liaison trusted by the defendant
contexts.goal_conflict: whether to recommend a plea deadline before a reluctant witness can be re-interviewed
contexts.information_asymmetry: the attorney knows the prosecution has a weak but admissible record; the liaison knows the defendant is concealing pressure from a relative
contexts.history_anchor: the family blamed the office after an earlier continuance increased detention time
contexts.verification_node: the witness interview and disclosure log later clarify what advice was justified

contexts.relationship_structure: an operations manager and a union safety steward
contexts.goal_conflict: whether to restore partial service with a temporary procedure after a signaling outage
contexts.information_asymmetry: the manager knows political pressure may eliminate future funding; the steward knows a near-miss was not entered in the shared log
contexts.history_anchor: both cooperated during a past shutdown but dispute who broke the return-to-work agreement
contexts.verification_node: telemetry and operator reports later show whether the temporary procedure was safe

contexts.relationship_structure: adult siblings sharing care for a parent with fluctuating capacity
contexts.goal_conflict: whether to move the parent to assisted living before a preferred place expires
contexts.information_asymmetry: one sibling knows a recent fall was more serious than reported; the other knows the parent's home-care benefit may be reinstated
contexts.history_anchor: years of unequal caregiving have made offers of help feel like criticism
contexts.verification_node: a capacity review and home-care decision later change the feasible options

contexts.relationship_structure: a producer and a senior designer representing a tired team
contexts.goal_conflict: whether to cut a promised feature or require a short crunch before a public launch
contexts.information_asymmetry: the producer knows the publisher may accept a delay; the designer knows key staff may quit even without formal complaints
contexts.history_anchor: the last milestone was saved by unpaid effort that was later described as good planning
contexts.verification_node: retention notices and launch defect data later expose the true trade-off

contexts.relationship_structure: a fund coordinator and a neighborhood donor who also refers applicants
contexts.goal_conflict: whether to make an exception for an urgent undocumented need when reserves are low
contexts.information_asymmetry: the coordinator sees confidential patterns across applications; the donor knows why this applicant cannot provide normal proof
contexts.history_anchor: an earlier exception was criticized after its rationale stayed private
contexts.verification_node: a later replenishment decision and anonymized audit test consistency without exposing the applicant

contexts.relationship_structure: a restaurant manager and an allergy-trained head chef
contexts.goal_conflict: whether to serve a large event after a supplier substitution cannot be fully verified
contexts.information_asymmetry: the chef knows cross-contact is plausible; the manager knows cancellation may default on wages
contexts.history_anchor: the manager previously backed the chef's stop-service call but later minimized it to investors
contexts.verification_node: supplier records and post-event testing later establish the actual contamination risk

contexts.relationship_structure: a museum curator and a community representative seeking return of an object
contexts.goal_conflict: whether to announce a long-term loan before provenance review is complete
contexts.information_asymmetry: the curator knows one acquisition document is likely unreliable; the representative knows community leadership is divided over the proposed custodian
contexts.history_anchor: an earlier consultation produced publicity but no transfer of authority
contexts.verification_node: the provenance panel and community vote later create a reviewable record

contexts.relationship_structure: a regional organizer and a shop steward at a precarious workplace
contexts.goal_conflict: whether to call a public action after management offers a narrow private concession
contexts.information_asymmetry: the organizer knows other sites are ready to join; the steward knows several outspoken workers cannot absorb lost shifts
contexts.history_anchor: a prior action won recognition but left disciplined workers feeling used
contexts.verification_node: scheduling records and the written concession later reveal who bore costs and what changed

contexts.relationship_structure: a child-welfare caseworker and a relative seeking temporary placement
contexts.goal_conflict: whether to approve an expedited placement before a home-study issue is resolved
contexts.information_asymmetry: the caseworker knows the current placement is deteriorating; the relative knows an adult in the home has recently returned
contexts.history_anchor: the relative previously withdrew during a crisis and believes the agency never heard the reason
contexts.verification_node: the home study and child's adjustment notes later test both safety and continuity

contexts.relationship_structure: a trial investigator and a patient advocate on the monitoring board
contexts.goal_conflict: whether to unblind a worrying subgroup signal before enrollment closes
contexts.information_asymmetry: the investigator knows the signal may be a data artifact; the advocate knows participants were told a narrower risk story
contexts.history_anchor: an earlier warning was deferred and later proved harmless, hardening both sides
contexts.verification_node: cleaned data and participant follow-up later determine whether early disclosure was warranted

contexts.relationship_structure: a water scheduler and a smallholder representative
contexts.goal_conflict: whether to change the rotation mid-season to protect the highest-value crops
contexts.information_asymmetry: the scheduler knows reservoir loss is worse than public estimates; the representative knows some smallholders are quietly sharing allotments
contexts.history_anchor: last year's emergency rule became permanent without the promised vote
contexts.verification_node: meter readings and harvest outcomes later expose distributional effects

contexts.relationship_structure: a host and a fact-checker who helped build the show
contexts.goal_conflict: whether to release an episode after the subject offers a late off-record explanation
contexts.information_asymmetry: the host knows a distributor may cancel if release slips; the fact-checker knows one key witness has merged two dates
contexts.history_anchor: a prior episode boosted the host's profile while correction work remained invisible
contexts.verification_node: phone records and a second interview later resolve the disputed timeline

contexts.relationship_structure: a security response lead and a client account director
contexts.goal_conflict: whether to isolate a major client's system before proof of compromise is conclusive
contexts.information_asymmetry: the lead sees anomalous credentials; the director knows isolation will interrupt a medically critical workflow
contexts.history_anchor: a previous false alarm damaged the client's willingness to cooperate
contexts.verification_node: forensic imaging and service-impact logs later reveal both breach scope and interruption cost

contexts.relationship_structure: a funeral director and an estranged relative chosen as family spokesperson
contexts.goal_conflict: whether to follow a prepaid plan that conflicts with newly expressed family wishes
contexts.information_asymmetry: the director has a signed but ambiguous amendment; the spokesperson knows the deceased reconciled privately with one excluded person
contexts.history_anchor: the family previously accused the spokesperson of controlling access during illness
contexts.verification_node: a scheduled reading of the planner's notes later clarifies intent without resolving every value conflict

contexts.relationship_structure: a clinic supervisor and a volunteer interpreter trusted by a family
contexts.goal_conflict: whether to file before a deadline using an account whose translation is uncertain
contexts.information_asymmetry: the supervisor knows late filing is likely fatal; the interpreter knows the speaker softened details out of fear of community exposure
contexts.history_anchor: the clinic once corrected this interpreter publicly, damaging candor
contexts.verification_node: a confidential second interpretation later tests accuracy and consent

contexts.relationship_structure: a head coach and a team physician
contexts.goal_conflict: whether to clear a star player for a championship after conflicting symptom reports
contexts.information_asymmetry: the physician knows the test baseline may be unreliable; the coach knows the player fears losing a scholarship if absence is recorded
contexts.history_anchor: the physician previously stopped another player and was blamed for the season's end
contexts.verification_node: independent assessment and later symptom tracking establish the medical trajectory

contexts.relationship_structure: a volunteer maintainer and an engineer from a company dependent on the project
contexts.goal_conflict: whether to merge an urgent vendor patch that bypasses the normal review queue
contexts.information_asymmetry: the maintainer sees an unresolved design risk; the engineer knows a public outage is already spreading
contexts.history_anchor: the company previously promised maintenance funding but redirected it
contexts.verification_node: post-incident traces and a scheduled architecture review reveal whether urgency justified the shortcut

contexts.relationship_structure: an artistic director and an accessibility coordinator
contexts.goal_conflict: whether to keep a celebrated lead whose rehearsal behavior excludes a disabled cast member
contexts.information_asymmetry: the director knows replacement threatens ticket sales; the coordinator knows the cast member wants a specific repair rather than removal
contexts.history_anchor: a previous complaint was generalized into a policy without acknowledging the harmed person
contexts.verification_node: documented rehearsal changes and cast feedback later show whether repair was substantive

contexts.relationship_structure: a shelter director and a behavior specialist
contexts.goal_conflict: whether to transfer a difficult dog to a rescue that has capacity but incomplete records
contexts.information_asymmetry: the specialist knows the risk assessment is improving; the director knows an intake surge will force euthanasia decisions
contexts.history_anchor: a past transfer failed after warnings were communicated only verbally
contexts.verification_node: follow-up behavior reports and intake records later establish consequences for both populations

contexts.relationship_structure: a loan officer and a financial counselor serving the same neighborhood
contexts.goal_conflict: whether to restructure a delinquent business loan outside standard criteria
contexts.information_asymmetry: the officer knows regulators are reviewing exceptions; the counselor knows the owner's cash gap comes from caring for an employee
contexts.history_anchor: an earlier flexible loan succeeded but was later cited as favoritism
contexts.verification_node: verified cash flow and the examination report later test fairness and viability

contexts.relationship_structure: a dig director and a local heritage officer
contexts.goal_conflict: whether to remove newly found material before an approaching storm
contexts.information_asymmetry: the director knows exposure may destroy evidence; the officer knows removal would violate a community consultation commitment
contexts.history_anchor: a prior emergency removal was never fully documented or returned
contexts.verification_node: weather damage records and council authorization later clarify what was preventable

contexts.relationship_structure: a program coordinator and an elder who teaches the language
contexts.goal_conflict: whether to release an unfinished learning app before school funding expires
contexts.information_asymmetry: the coordinator knows teachers need materials now; the elder knows several recordings contain context that makes broad use inappropriate
contexts.history_anchor: earlier materials credited the institution more prominently than speakers
contexts.verification_node: classroom use and a speaker review later reveal educational value and cultural harm

contexts.relationship_structure: a maintenance supervisor and a pilots' safety representative
contexts.goal_conflict: whether to return an aircraft to service after a recurring fault cannot be reproduced
contexts.information_asymmetry: the supervisor knows the fleet schedule is collapsing; the representative knows two crews described the same subtle symptom
contexts.history_anchor: a previous precautionary grounding was mocked after no defect was found
contexts.verification_node: flight-data analysis and component teardown later establish the failure mechanism

contexts.relationship_structure: a startup founder and the scientist who developed a key assay
contexts.goal_conflict: whether to file a broad patent before a university ownership question is resolved
contexts.information_asymmetry: the founder knows investors require filing; the scientist knows a former technician made an uncredited contribution
contexts.history_anchor: the scientist accepted delayed recognition during an earlier emergency submission
contexts.verification_node: lab notebooks and the university review later establish inventorship

contexts.relationship_structure: a congregation board chair and a volunteer sponsor close to a newly arrived family
contexts.goal_conflict: whether to accept a restricted donor gift that requires public storytelling
contexts.information_asymmetry: the chair knows the housing fund is nearly empty; the sponsor knows the family agreed only because they misunderstood the audience
contexts.history_anchor: a prior fundraiser blurred the line between gratitude and consent
contexts.verification_node: a translated consent review and donor decision later reveal whether alternatives existed

contexts.relationship_structure: a producer and a participant advocate
contexts.goal_conflict: whether to retain a revealing scene after the participant requests withdrawal near picture lock
contexts.information_asymmetry: the producer knows the scene is central to funder expectations; the advocate knows the participant faces a newly emerged retaliation risk
contexts.history_anchor: the production previously promised shared review without defining veto power
contexts.verification_node: distribution negotiations and a safety assessment later make the costs concrete

contexts.relationship_structure: a wedding planner and a family elder financing much of the event
contexts.goal_conflict: whether to cancel a culturally important vendor after a private complaint
contexts.information_asymmetry: the planner knows the complaint is credible but incomplete; the elder knows cancellation will revive a painful family dispute
contexts.history_anchor: the couple earlier delegated decisions to avoid conflict, then objected to being excluded
contexts.verification_node: the vendor response and couple's direct decision later clarify authority and risk

contexts.relationship_structure: a fisheries scientist and a small-fleet representative
contexts.goal_conflict: whether to recommend an immediate closure based on an uncertain stock estimate
contexts.information_asymmetry: the scientist knows the model is sensitive to one missing survey; the representative knows some boats are underreporting bycatch
contexts.history_anchor: a past closure preserved stock but concentrated losses on compliant crews
contexts.verification_node: the next survey and landing audits later test both conservation and equity claims

contexts.relationship_structure: a unit supervisor and an experienced caseworker
contexts.goal_conflict: whether to override a family's safety plan after a concerning but ambiguous home visit
contexts.information_asymmetry: the supervisor sees a pattern across cases; the caseworker knows this family's apparent noncompliance has a specific language barrier
contexts.history_anchor: a previous override prevented harm but ruptured a different family's cooperation
contexts.verification_node: a translated visit and collateral report later clarify the immediate risk

contexts.relationship_structure: a library director and a youth librarian
contexts.goal_conflict: whether to pause a contested program after threats while publicly defending access
contexts.information_asymmetry: the director knows insurers may withdraw event coverage; the librarian knows targeted teenagers interpret silence as abandonment
contexts.history_anchor: an earlier security response protected staff but exposed attendee identities
contexts.verification_node: attendance, incident, and insurer records later reveal which protections worked

contexts.relationship_structure: an adult mentor and a student team captain
contexts.goal_conflict: whether to disclose that a winning component received prohibited outside help
contexts.information_asymmetry: the mentor knows disclosure may disqualify scholarships; the captain knows teammates believed the help was allowed
contexts.history_anchor: the mentor previously encouraged aggressive use of expert contacts
contexts.verification_node: the competition review and scholarship committee later separate intent, responsibility, and remedy

contexts.relationship_structure: a county election clerk and a nonpartisan community observer
contexts.goal_conflict: whether to extend voting at one site after an equipment failure without a court order
contexts.information_asymmetry: the clerk knows other sites had shorter disruptions; the observer knows transportation barriers uniquely magnified this outage
contexts.history_anchor: a prior emergency decision was attacked as partisan despite symmetric intent
contexts.verification_node: machine logs and judicial review later establish duration and legal authority

contexts.relationship_structure: a support-group moderator and a pharmaceutical patient liaison
contexts.goal_conflict: whether to share preliminary expanded-access news before eligibility rules are final
contexts.information_asymmetry: the liaison knows early attention may accelerate approval; the moderator knows members have begun making irreversible financial plans
contexts.history_anchor: a past hopeful announcement produced both access and severe disappointment
contexts.verification_node: the published protocol later reveals who qualifies and what risks were omitted

contexts.relationship_structure: an admissions dean and a scholarship director
contexts.goal_conflict: whether to admit a borderline applicant before a donor-funded scholarship condition is clarified
contexts.information_asymmetry: the dean knows the applicant's context supports admission; the director knows the donor may impose an unlawful preference
contexts.history_anchor: the offices previously traded exceptions without recording their rationales
contexts.verification_node: legal review and the applicant's verified file later test both equity and process

contexts.relationship_structure: an operations manager and a disability advocate
contexts.goal_conflict: whether to tighten identification checks after inventory losses
contexts.information_asymmetry: the manager knows another shortage will cancel deliveries; the advocate knows the proposed queue excludes homebound clients
contexts.history_anchor: an earlier anti-fraud change shifted unpaid verification work onto volunteers
contexts.verification_node: delivery completion and loss audits later reveal both access and control effects

contexts.relationship_structure: a preservation architect and a tenant-association representative
contexts.goal_conflict: whether to begin a grant-funded retrofit that temporarily displaces residents
contexts.information_asymmetry: the architect knows delay may forfeit funds; the representative knows promised temporary housing is not accessible for two tenants
contexts.history_anchor: a previous consultation approved design goals but not relocation terms
contexts.verification_node: housing inspections and grant milestones later establish whether a safer sequence was feasible

contexts.relationship_structure: a department manager and a long-serving team lead
contexts.goal_conflict: whether to promote a highly visible remote employee over a quieter colleague carrying coordination work
contexts.information_asymmetry: the manager sees output metrics favoring one candidate; the lead knows whose invisible interventions prevented repeated failures
contexts.history_anchor: the lead was previously asked to mentor without receiving decision authority
contexts.verification_node: a project retrospective and peer evidence later make contributions more observable

contexts.relationship_structure: a health-data director and a clinic-network representative
contexts.goal_conflict: whether to publish a neighborhood dashboard before small-cell privacy risks are resolved
contexts.information_asymmetry: the director knows delay weakens an outbreak response; the representative knows one category could identify stigmatized patients locally
contexts.history_anchor: a prior aggregate release was technically legal but damaged clinic trust
contexts.verification_node: privacy testing and intervention uptake later reveal both informational value and harm
